lesson:prompt.capital_of__note: Question prompt. {country} is a localised country name from the content pack.
lesson:prompt.locate__note: Map question prompt. {country} is a localised name from the content pack.
lesson:feedback.correct.title: Perfect!
lesson:feedback.correct.title__note: Celebration headline after a correct answer. One word, one exclamation mark maximum.
lesson:feedback.correct.body__note: Shown under the celebration headline. {country} is a localised name.
lesson:feedback.wrong.title: That's {chosen}.
lesson:feedback.wrong.title__note: NEVER 'Wrong!' or 'Oops!'. State the truth plainly — no exclamation mark, no sad emoji. See docs/design/voice-and-tone.md.
lesson:feedback.wrong.body__note: Used ONLY when a hint exists (flag descriptions). Names the right answer and gives one memorable hook.
lesson:answer.label: {country}
lesson:answer.label__note: Accessibility label for an answer option button.
lesson:leave.confirm: Leave lesson? Your progress is saved.
lesson:summary.title: Nice work.
lesson:summary.title__note: End-of-lesson headline. Satisfied and closing — never urging another lesson.
lesson:hearts.empty.title: Out of hearts
lesson:hearts.empty.title__note: Headline when hearts run out. Neutral and factual, never a punishment.
lesson:hearts.empty.body: Hearts come back over time. Practice mode is always free.
lesson:hearts.empty.body__note: Critical: must make clear that learning is NEVER blocked.
lesson:progress.label: Progress
lesson:progress.label__note: Label above the lesson progress bar. Max 10 chars.
lesson:hearts.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {No hearts left} one {# heart left} other {# hearts left}}
lesson:hearts.remaining__note: Accessibility label for the hearts indicator. ICU plural.
lesson:reward.xp__note: Accessibility label for the XP chip. Spoken, so it is a full phrase.
lesson:reward.coins__note: Accessibility label for the coin chip.
lesson:empty.title: You're all caught up
lesson:empty.title__note: Shown when nothing is due. Celebrate it — never a dead end.
lesson:empty.body: Nothing is due right now. Explore somewhere new?
lesson:empty.body__note: Empty state body. Always offers the next step.
lesson:prompt.capital_reverse: {valueName} is the capital of which country?
lesson:prompt.capital_reverse__note: Reverse capital question. {valueName} is a city name.
lesson:prompt.flag_described__note: Screen-reader-safe flag question. {description} is a phrase like "a red circle on a white field".
lesson:feedback.wrong.bodyPlain__note: Used when the fact carries no descriptive hint, e.g. a capital. Still states the answer plainly — never just "wrong".
